The accused in Crime No.210/2023 registered by the Halebeedu Police Station, Hassan, for the offences punishable under Sections 376 and 417 of IPC, is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. On the basis of the complaint lodged by the victim dated 20.09.2023, FIR in Crime No.210/2023,
was registered by Halebeedu Police Station, Hassan, against the petitioner herein for the aforesaid offences.
In the complaint, it is averred that the victim and the petitioner are acquainted with each other for the last five years and they were in love.
It is also averred that they used to meet very often and the petitioner allegedly had promised to marry the victim and had sexual intercourse with her.
It is averred that subsequently, the petitioner has informed the victim that he has no intention to marry her.
It is in this background, the victim had approached the police on 20.09.2023 and lodged a complaint, based on which, the FIR in Crime No.210/2023 was registered against the petitioner.
During the course of investigation of the case, the petitioner was arrested on 22.09.2023.

His bail application filed before the III Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Hassan in Crl. Misc.
No.1224/2023 was rejected on 21.10.2023.

entities.text: III Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Hassan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Therefore, the petitioner is before this Court.
5. Learned Counsel for the petitioner reiterating the grounds urged in the petition prays to allow the petition.
6. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the bail petition.
7. From a reading of the complaint averments, it is seen that petitioner and victim were in love and are known to each other for the last five years.
The victim girl is aged about 24 years.
The allegations in the complaint is that by promising to marry, the petitioner allegedly had sexual intercourse with her.

Considering the nature of allegations made in the complaint, a serious doubt arises as to whether based on the allegations made in the complaint, offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC would get attracted against the petitioner or NC: 2023:KHC:40930 whether only offence Teja G.E. Teju vs State By Halebeedu Police on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98254575/
2 punishable under Section 417 of IPC would get attracted.

entities.text: Teja G.E. Teju vs State By Halebeedu Police
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. Be that as it may, considering the nature of allegations made in the complaint and also taking into account the fact that petitioner and victim girl, who is a major, were in love, I am of the opinion that the prayer made for grant of regular bail is required to be answered in the affirmative.

Accordingly,
the following order:-
9.
The petition is allowed.
